raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "jsmin" %}
{% set version = "3.0.1" %}


package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/{{ name[0] }}/{{ name }}/jsmin-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: c0959a121ef94542e807a674142606f7e90214a2b3d1eb17300244bbb5cc2bfc

build:
  number: 1
  noarch: python
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  host:
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - setuptools
    - pip
  run:
    - python >={{ python_min }}

test:
  imports:
    - jsmin
  commands:
    - pip check
  requires:
    - pip
    - python {{ python_min }}

about:
  home: https://github.com/tikitu/jsmin/
  summary: JavaScript minifier.
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE.txt

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - ocefpaf
    - daf
